name: TextArea
description: Multi-line field for the user to write long text. Supports a visible label and a value that can scroll inside the box.

dos: Always provide a visible label (`label`): the placeholder does not replace the label.
Use the placeholder only as a short content example: "Describe the problem in as much detail as possible".
Use `variant="surface"` by default; `classic` if the field should stand out with a shadow; `soft` on neutral backgrounds.
Choose `size` by screen density: 1 for compact notes, 2 by default, 3 for main texts.
Use `readOnly` if the text can be copied and `disabled` if it is unavailable.

donts.why: A text area is taller than needed and adds nothing for a short value.
Typing invites format errors and does not validate against the list.

donts.case: Using the placeholder as a label
donts.why: It disappears when typing and has low contrast.

donts.useInstead: A dedicated editor (there is no component in the system)
donts.why: TextArea only handles plain text; it has no formatting toolbar or rich selection.

related.difference: Single line; the height neither grows nor scrolls vertically.

props.name: variant
props.description: Appearance. surface = light background with border; classic = same with shadow; soft = faint accent fill with no border.

props.name: size
props.description: Size: height 48 / 64 / 80 px, with its text, radius and spacing. 2 is the default.

props.name: disabled
props.description: If true, it cannot be focused or edited. In Figma it is the "disable" value of the `state` axis.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: If true, the value is visible and can be focused and copied, but not edited. In Figma it is the "read-only" value of the `state` axis.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label above the box. If omitted, it is not shown (in Figma, the `label` boolean hides it). Text size depends on size.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Example text while the box is empty.

props.name: value
props.description: Typed text. In Figma, `state=filled` and `state=read-only` show this text; `state=placeholder` and `state=active` show the placeholder.

controlled.name: disabled
controlled.description: Cannot be focused or edited. Text and background use neutral tokens; never opacity.

controlled.name: readOnly
controlled.description: Shows the value; can be focused and copied, not edited.

root.description: Box container (border, background, radius, shadow). The textarea lives inside.

label.description: Visible label above the box. Associated with the textarea via htmlFor.

focusRing.description: Not an element: painted with :focus-visible. In Figma it is a layer shown with the focusRing boolean.

scrollBar.description: Vertical scroll bar for the text when it does not fit in the box. In code, the browser's native one (overflow: auto).

resize.description: Resize handle in the bottom corner. In Figma it is a layer (resize) shown with the resize boolean.

textarea.description: Native field. Shows the placeholder when empty and the value when filled. Enter inserts a line break.

height.note: No height token in Figma: loose values. These are fixed heights; text that does not fit scrolls inside the box. With a visible label the total height grows.

modes.fill: Fills the container width. In Figma, 200px as an example.
modes.fixed: Decided by whoever uses the component.

autoLayout.direction: VERTICAL (label above the box); the box is HORIZONTAL
autoLayout.gap: Between label and box: spacing.1 in size 1; spacing.2 in size 2 and 3 (copied from TextField, not measured in Figma)

a11y.name: The label (label) associated via htmlFor. With no visible label, aria-label is required.
keyboard: Arrows — move the cursor within the text
Escape — does nothing on its own
a11y.focusIndicator: Double ring: 4px outer with colors.accent.accent-alpha.8 and 2px inner with colors.accent.accent.3 (focusRing layer). The border also changes to accent-alpha.8 in the active state.
a11y.minTarget: At least 48px tall in size 1 (the whole box is the target); 64 and 80 in size 2 and 3.
a11y.contrastNote: Text ≥ 4.5:1 and field border ≥ 3:1 against the background (WCAG 1.4.11). Not measured in Figma; the placeholder uses neutral-alpha.9, which should be checked.

form.note: Figma defines no error, help text or invalid state.

placeholder.voice: Content example: "Describe the problem in as much detail as possible"

behavior.overflow: vertical scroll inside the box; height is fixed per size

cases: disabled receives no focus and emits no onChange
readOnly receives focus and emits no onChange
Enter inserts a line break and does not submit forms
text exceeding the height shows vertical scroll and does not change the box height
the label is associated with the textarea (clicking the label focuses the field)
with no visible label, aria-label is missing and the accessibility check fails
each variant × state uses the tokens in tokens.bindings

needsReview: Figma defaults: the component set has size "1", variant "classic" and state "placeholder ✦" as default, but the ✦ marks are on size "2", variant "surface" and state "placeholder". The contract uses those marked with ✦ (2, surface, placeholder); confirm which prevails.
Figma has no hover state. There are only placeholder, active, filled, disable and read-only; hover is left undesigned.
placeholder and filled are the same component with or without a value; in Figma they are distinct states. active = focused, with the cursor drawn as text.
disabled only shows the placeholder: there is no variant of a disabled field with a value.

Fixed heights 48 / 64 / 80, no token. With 3 sizes there is no rows prop: Figma does not define a number of lines. Decide whether the height is fixed (as here) or grows with the content (field-sizing), and whether a rows prop is added.
Resize handle (resize boolean, 6×6px layer): there is no prop in code. Decide whether to expose it as a prop (e.g. resize: none | vertical) or leave it to the browser's native CSS.
Scroll bar (scrollBar boolean): the instance is hidden by default. In code the browser's native one is used; confirm that a custom scroll bar design is not implemented.
Horizontal padding read in Figma (Spacing/1, Spacing/2, Spacing/3 by size). Vertical padding and the label gap were not read: the gap was copied from TextField.
Radius: size 1 and 2 use Radius/2 (radius.2) and size 3 uses Radius/3 (radius.3). Read in Figma.
Text style: the field uses Typography/N/Regular (read). The label uses text-style.N.medium copied from TextField; not read in TextArea.
Focus ring (focusRing): the 4px outer and 2px inner values are copied from TextField; they were not read in the focus-ring layer of TextArea.
classic also uses shadows.shadow-1 in disabled (copied from TextField; not checked in Figma for TextArea). In read-only it has no shadow.
No error, help text or required field in Figma.
Placeholder contrast (neutral-alpha.9) and border contrast (neutral-alpha.5/.6) not measured.
